summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Vesta Real Estate Corporation, S.A.B. de C.V. announcing the closing of a global follow-on offering of ADSs in the U.S. and common shares in Mexico. The offering comprised 1,199,285 ADSs at US$34.62 per ADS and 58,054,784 common shares at Ps.$59.50 per share. Gross proceeds were ~US$242.5 million, to fund growth strategy. Barclays, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley acted as joint global coordinators. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation, as it involves an ordinary follow-on offering without any change of control, delisting, or restructuring.
